snippets.title: Madhu Guru on coding and models
snippets.takeaway: Part of the disconnect is that the name “data” massively undersells what it truly represents in model development.
snippets.summary: Madhu Guru (realmadhuguru on X) shared 2 recent updates. Part of the disconnect is that the name “data” massively undersells what it truly represents in model development. People who are not close to model development think of data as this inert commodity you buy and shovel into a model, like coal. In reality great data encodes incredibly high value knowledge, taste and expertise, often articulated and structured in ways that did not exist previously.
